admissionRule.statement: Admission compares the package's resolved installed astro version for exact equality with an admitted release. A declared range is never read (R08). Any other resolved version, including another 7.3 patch, is unsupported-version with its reason and is never coerced (R06). Moving the admitted release to a later patch is an amendment of this lock, never an implicit widening.

nextChannel.rationale: framework-common admits the current stable major plus the next major once it is announced and ratified at stage 0. 7.4.0-beta.1 is a prerelease of a minor inside the admitted 7 major, not a next major; no Astro 8 prerelease is published (the registry alpha tag still names 7.0.0-alpha.2). A beta is never admitted as a second profile of the same major.
reratifyWhen: astro 7.4.0 stable is published: amend admittedReleases to the exact 7.4 release (one release per manifest, R04)
an astro 8 prerelease is published and announced: a second profile may be admitted only by a ratified amendment of this lock

excludedLines.note: not a profile; a resolved 5.x is unsupported-version
not a profile; a resolved 6.x is unsupported-version

excludedLines.note: R07: never decodes into a release

toolingOracles.rule: Test-only oracles, each a single npm devDependency of the conformance harness (framework-common Evidence). Never a product parser, resolver, type owner or projection source. Compared structurally (AST9-AC2); AST6 generates its own projection. The harness pins the transitive and platform package closure hermetically; published dependency ranges below are provenance, not pins or proof of an installed resolution.

selection.basis: astro 7.3.8 declares @astrojs/compiler-rs ^0.5.1; @astrojs/language-server 2.17.1 declares @astrojs/astro2tsx ^0.1.0. The selected exact oracle versions are 0.5.1 and 0.1.2, respectively. @astrojs/compiler 4.0.0 is not in the admitted release's declared dependencies and is excluded from this oracle set.
selection.authority: The dedicated Verter frontend remains the parser authority (PAR0 CL11/PD04); AST6 remains the projection owner. Neither upstream output feeds a production path.
selection.evidenceLimit: Published metadata establishes package provenance, not grammar, diagnostic or projection compatibility. AST1 proves lossless grammar and recovery; AST9-AC2 compares the pinned oracles structurally in the hermetic harness.

exclusions.build: Official astro build and astro dev output and their source maps are never consumed (no BND bridge); AST6 is the TS-host projection.
exclusions.maps: No DBG, TST or WPF map is promised for Astro.
exclusions.runtime: No Astro runtime, renderer, adapter, integration, dev server or config is executed, rendered, hydrated or instrumented. A value that needs evaluation is unknown.
